title: MCR3U Functions Quiz
subtitle: 3 questions. Pick before the timer hits zero.
endPrompt: How many did you get right?

questions.prompt: What is the maximum value of $f(x)=3\sin\left(2\left(x-45^\circ\right)\right)+5$?
questions.explanation: The maximum is the midline plus the amplitude: $5+3=8$.

questions.prompt: If $f(5)=2$ and $f$ is periodic with period $10$, what is $\left(f(15)\right)^2$?
How many real solutions does $x^2+2x+3=0$ have?
questions.explanation: The discriminant is $2^2-4(1)(3)=-8$, so there are no real solutions.
